# PenPilot Studio

> PenPilot Studio is an India-based handwriting and formatting service. Customers send photos of their own notes, drafts or practical content on WhatsApp, and PenPilot Studio rewrites them as neat, legible handwritten pages, formatted and delivered on an agreed date. Website available in English and Hindi.

## Services
- Fair copies: neat handwritten fair copies of content the customer provides, page-numbered.
- Practical files: lab records written from the customer's own observations and readings, with index, tables and labelled diagrams.
- Notes: messy class notes rewritten into clean, readable notebooks.
- Projects and PPTs: formatting and design for project files and presentations, using the customer's content.

## How to order
1. Send clear photos of your content and the format to follow on WhatsApp: +91 86303 51527 (https://wa.me/918630351527).
2. Receive a quote on WhatsApp. Asking for a quote is free.
3. Pay after accepting the quote.
4. Receive the pages on the agreed date (scanned copy on WhatsApp, local pickup or courier).

## Policy
PenPilot Studio does not solve questions or produce original academic work. It only rewrites, formats and presents content supplied by the customer. Customers are responsible for following the academic rules of their institution. Users under 18 should order with a parent or guardian's consent.
